description: Generated visual ground truth: empty labeled box (0–2s), one blue block in box (2–4s), closed taped box (4–6s), black view (6–8s). The portrait variant uses the same facts with a different viewport. Additional 16s clips show colored-part sorting (including a wrong bin, recovery, and an extra green triangle) and panel inspection (OFF/ON, connection loss, red/green indicator, and a 42 V display). Each has an obstruction at 8–10s. This is a synthetic process benchmark, not clinical validation.
